description: The day's progress drafted from the record. text is the day's post (Bluesky): it leads with what moved toward the aim (the day's session summaries and moves, in the user's words), then the main step done or not, the aim and its progress, and, if there is room, the week against the target, minutes on the aim and on hard work (never with quiet numbers), routines, comebacks; at most 300 characters, ending with aimyear.com. wip_todos is for WIP: one todo per project worked on that day, about what was done on it, with that project's #hashtag (none when it has no hashtag). Per network: ready, already posted, or skipped because the user already posted there that day. nothing_to_post: true means nothing is recorded toward the aim that day: there is no text; ask the user what they did and record it (add_move) before drafting again. Posts nothing. Pro.
name: get_post_draft
title: Get post draft
